spawnPoints.name: Return from The Shrine of the Nine Lost

heightEncoding.note: The grid is authoritative for walkability. The Godot loader takes elevation from the rendered walk surfaces, not from this file.

notes: Every terrain sub-mesh is named Terrain_<class>; every authored walkable surface is named Walk_<...>. The client turns both into the navigation collision layer the grounding ray tests against.
Structural geometry - terrace retaining walls, temple mass, arcade piers, tree trunks - is deliberately not a walk surface, so the grounding ray never snaps an actor onto a roof or the top of a wall.
The stair is terraced, so cliff risers are steep by design and appear as GROUNDING_DISCONTINUITY warnings wherever a terrace meets the one below it.
